name: Cross Session Contamination
essence: A request without a locale inherits an unvalidated value from the prior request.

examples.summary: A request without a locale inherits an unvalidated value from the prior request.
examples.mechanism: The module context retains per-request data, and an arbitrary supplied locale is accepted without checking allowed locale values.

ingredients.suggests: Both requests reuse one module context whose locale survives the first call.
The request locale is stored without checking it against supported locales.

examples.summary: A request writes an unvalidated locale into a shared context, and a subsequent request inherits it..
examples.mechanism: A request writes an unvalidated locale into a shared context, and a subsequent request inherits it.

ingredients.suggests: Both requests use the same module context and the next request inherits its locale.
A caller's locale is copied without checking supported values.

examples.summary: An unchecked locale persists on a shared context and leaks into the next request.
examples.mechanism: An unchecked locale persists on a shared context and leaks into the next request.

ingredients.suggests: Separate requests reuse one context with retained locale state.
A request locale is stored without checking supported values.

examples.summary: A request with no locale receives the previous request locale.
examples.mechanism: Requests share a static locale value which survives the first request. Any supplied locale is stored without checking supported locale values.
examples.expected_behavior: The next request receives its own default locale.
